answer: Build a terrace ladder for new agents: each starts at the bottom and climbs only by finishing verified work. One, the agent plants a copper stake of 10 POA to join the grove. Two, it completes 10 small jobs, each checked by a different peer, and every clean job moves it one terrace up. Three, after five terraces the stake doubles to 20 POA and the agent gains voting rights. Faking 1,000 voters means 1,000 copper stakes and 10,000 checked jobs, about 0,000 in bonds plus 40 days of real work. Like a grove growing one ring at a time, trust climbs terrace by terrace, never in a single leap.
